tasks.short: Direct training and report its status

steps.what: Direct firefighter training priorities and resolve training needs
Assign instructors to training classes and confirm arrangements
Compile and check reports on training progress and status for supervisors

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} training-status reports from confirmed assignments and instructor completion records. Retain training direction, instructor selection and final status interpretation; no model evaluates competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training status may be recopied from class records into a separate report.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing learning records can be grouped by class and required qualification.
tasks.still_hard: Completion does not itself establish operational competence.
tasks.human_edge: Judge training priorities and explain gaps to management.
tasks.altitude: Less training report assembly, with training responsibility unchanged.

reach.task: Record training completion and unresolved learning needs

evidence.claim: Configured learning reports may replace repeated compilation; no measured fire-training reporting result is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor training direction, instructor assignment and reporting, excluding delivery of training.

Supervisor produces class id, instructor, dates and training requirement in fully retained s2. Instructor records participant id, attendance, completion date and unresolved status during existing class administration with unchanged capture time.

Supervisor reconciles missing completions, defines reporting cutoff and checks report meaning within s3's15 retained hours. Missing source records require manual confirmation rather than inferred completion.
Test native report configuration first; additional source-entry issues are counted below.
research_questions: Does native reporting reduce compilation after missing completions are reconciled?

already_counted.description: Reconcile missing inputs and check final report

incremental.description: Maintain status definitions and resolve reporting exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact reporting cutoff, participant records, completion definitions and report version; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gross15 less3 upkeep =12 net E1. High needs manual compilation; low covers existing native reports or incomplete instructor records.

steps.what: Review observations and evidence of assigned firefighting personnel's performance
Evaluate performance with the employee and agree development priorities

tasks.design: Retain evidence review and the performance conversation, using existing {HCM} records. No worker scoring model is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance needs contextual interpretation and an opportunity for employee response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support the unchanged review.
tasks.still_hard: Separating individual contribution from incident circumstances and team conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Make a fair assessment and give useful feedback.
tasks.altitude: Evaluation responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Evidence standards and employee response rights

evidence.claim: Human evidence review and employee discussion remain fully counted.

assumptions: Boundary is performance evaluation, excluding later personnel action recommendations.
Supervisor supplies direct observations and reads existing records in s1; employee supplies their perspective in s2. No structured behaviour score is assumed.
No new monitoring, configuration or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Does each assessment allow the employee's explanation of incident context?

approvals.approved_version: Exact evidence set, employee response and evaluation version; changes require renewed supervisor assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; assessment and employee discussion remain.

steps.what: Gather and verify facts needed for administrative records, forms and reports
Compile records, complete forms and draft reports or correspondence

loop.purpose: Draft administrative narrative from verified facts
loop.input: Verified facts, source references, document purpose and approved structure
loop.output: Draft with source-linked factual statements and marked gaps
loop.check: Supervisor compares meaning, chronology, omissions and recipient implications against the source facts
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported events, unclear attribution or sensitive content return to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields cover routine forms but cannot express all narrative correspondence

steps.what: Review and release the final administrative document to its authorised destination

tasks.design: Test native {OPS_SYSTEM} exports and {DOCS} forms before adding a bounded narrative drafting loop. Keep fact gathering, meaning checks and final release with the supervisor; no operational command or personnel decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified facts are repeatedly reassembled into several administrative formats.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates handle fixed fields and constrained drafting can assist narrative sections.
tasks.still_hard: Missing context and unsupported narrative can erase the expected saving.
tasks.human_edge: Know what happened and what the recipient needs to understand.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly only where correction time remains low.

evidence.claim: Anchorage's police drafting trial found review consumed the apparent time saving; this cautions against assuming draft speed equals net benefit for fire administration.
The proposed fire administrative drafting savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is generic supervisor administration. Training reports and performance or disciplinary work belong to their specific tasks and must be allocated once.

Supervisor produces document purpose, recipient, dates, source references and verified facts in s1's full35 hours. Existing incident authors retain original reporting; no new structured capture is shifted to them.
Missing facts require direct verification before drafting; corrections and meaning review remain20 hours in s2 plus25 in final review.
Native forms and exports come first. A loop is used only for permitted narrative with approved access; existing system runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Do timed complete-document trials show a net reduction after source checks and final release?

already_counted.description: Verify and capture the factual input pack

incremental.description: Maintain structures and review recurring drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact document text, source pack and authorised recipient or file destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 less4 upkeep =16 net E1. High needs repeated assembly; low assumes draft correction removes all gross gain while upkeep remains, consistent with the adjacent police trial caution.

steps.what: Review personnel circumstances, applicable procedures and employee representations
Recommend actions for disciplinary procedures, performance, absence or grievances

tasks.design: Retain case review and personnel recommendations with the supervisor, supported by existing {HCM} and {DOCS}. No automatic recommendation or employee risk score is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personnel cases require context, due process and accountable judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case records support the unchanged process.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling evidence, procedure and the employee's account.
tasks.human_edge: Make a proportionate recommendation and explain its reasons.

evidence.claim: The design retains individual case review and personnel recommendations without labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor case review and recommendation; HR review and the final employer decision remain outside.
Existing case owners supply source records; supervisor captures case-specific reasons during fully retained s2. No structured recommendation code is assumed.
Performance evaluation counted in task22917 is not added again here; this task covers the subsequent action recommendation.
No new system, monitoring or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which cases require HR consultation before a recommendation is formed?

approvals.approved_version: Exact case evidence, employee representations, reasons and recommendation; changed facts require renewed supervisor review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; individual case judgement remains.

reach: Work with instructors and records staff on traceable source records
